effectiveTerms: MIT for Ikemen GO and for this core; BSD-3-Clause for the Go runtime; the Go modules inside under their own permissive licences (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, the FreeType License, the Unlicense), with their texts in go-modules.txt; MIT for libxmp and Mesa; Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception for LLVM
note: The built core combines this repository's code (MIT): the glue in go/chimera, the stand-ins for SDL 2's and FFmpeg's Go bindings in go/sdl2 and go/reisen, and the build scripts; Ikemen GO (MIT), compiled from the submodule extern/Ikemen-GO (v1.0.0) as a C archive with this repository's patches/ applied, with its engine files (data/, external/, font/) inside; the Go runtime and standard library (BSD-3-Clause, Go 1.27.3 with waterbox/go-patches applied); the Go modules Ikemen GO imports, each under the licence go-modules.txt gives (golang/freetype under the FreeType License: portions of this software are copyright The FreeType Project, www.freetype.org); libxmp (MIT); Mesa (MIT), whose llvmpipe driver behind OSMesa is the OpenGL Ikemen GO draws with (waterbox/mesa-patches applied); and LLVM (Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception), which llvmpipe compiles shaders with. The package carries no game: the project brings the game folder as a zip.
